lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixel clusters of varying diameters (approx. 5-15 pixels) forming a sparse, irregular grid pattern posterior to the gill slits and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with the primary high-luminance blobs to create a localized grid-like arrangement on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature across the upper lateral flank characterized by a sharp vertical transition from high-intensity (upper) to low-intensity (lower) pixels, indicating a physical ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small yellow teleost fish in the lower-right quadrant; significant light refraction (caustics) patterns visible across the entire dorsal surface of the specimen.
